verdict.rationale: Galileo is an evaluation and observability platform that could plausibly version its prompt templates, metrics, or alert configurations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents versioning, change review, or rollback of any automation. The annotation queues (galileo-docs-40) are for human review of traces and spans, not of automation changes, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
